title: Curing and interval.
officialText:
First and second coats of cement plaster shall be applied and moist cured as set forth in ASTM C
926 and Table 2512.6.
TABLE 2512.6
CEMENT PLASTERSa
MINIMUM PERIOD MOIST MINIMUM INTERVAL
COAT CURING BETWEEN COATS
First 48 hoursa 48 hoursb
Second 48 hours 7 daysc
Finish — Note c
a. The first two coats shall be as required for the first coats of exterior plaster, except that the moist-curing time period between the first and second coats shall
not be less than 24 hours. Moist curing shall not be required where job and weather conditions are favorable to the retention of moisture in the cement
plaster for the required time period.
b. Twenty-four-hour minimum interval between coats of interior cement plaster. For alternate method of application, see Section 2512.8.
c. Finish coat plaster is permitted to be applied to interior cement base coats after a 48-hour period.
